statement.description:
In the Netherlands, except on expiry of the fixed term (or during probation), an employee cannot be terminated without the consent of the authorities. For this reason, we recommend you engage employees on a fixed term agreement of 7 to 12 months in the first instance and utilise the maximum fixed term agreements thereafter.

Why a minimum of 7 months? Because we also recommend including a probation period and probation periods are not valid in fixed term agreements of 6 months or less.

x-jsf-presentation.description:
Pension contributions include a 15.2% employer contribution toward retirement, approximately 0.6% for risk coverage (death and disability), and a 4.8% employee contribution.

Contributions are calculated based on the pensionable salary (gross salary minus a franchise of €18,475).

Note: In the Netherlands, participation in a group pension scheme is mandatory under Remote’s model. This benefit must be selected and will apply to all employees in the country.

In this section, you can select benefits for your new team member. If you have existing team members in the same country, your new hire will receive the same benefits as those currently provided to other team members there, maintaining benefit equality. If this is your first hire in the country, you may select from the available options below. Your choice will become the standard benefits for any future hires in the country.
x-jsf-presentation.extra: Prices are listed in U.S. Dollars (USD). However, when benefits are originally priced in local currencies, these amounts are estimates in USD. The final charge in local currency will be determined using the exchange rate at the time of invoicing. The pricing listed is subject to change based on the age of the employee (age banding) and/or plan changes/renewals. Any pricing changes will be communicated in advance.
